summary: Data scientist with experience in applied analytics, statistical modeling, and budget forecasting within governmental environments. Skilled in Python, SQL, and data visualization, with hands-on experience developing machine learning models, analyzing large-scale financial datasets, and translating complex quantitative insights into actionable recommendations for senior management. Experienced in leveraging modern AI tools to enhance analytical workflows and productivity.

education.description: B.Sc. Mathematics at \textbf{The Technion -- Israel Institute of Technology} (Cum Laude)

experience.title: Junior Data Scientist, Budget Department, Israeli Ministry of Defense
description: Was responsible for providing statistical analysis and decision support to management
Extracted and processed complex financial datasets using SQL from large-scale institutional databases
Conducted statistical and exploratory data analysis to identify spending trends and anomalies
Designed, implemented, and presented predictive models for budget forecasting of approximately ILS 120 billion
Built yearly expenditure forecasting models to support strategic planning

experience.title: Budget Officer, Personnel Directorate, Israel Defense Forces
description: Was responsible for administering a budget of approximately ILS 150 million and coordinating with internal stakeholders and senior management
Oversaw operational budgets for a medium-sized IDF unit, ensuring efficient allocation of resources
Identified significiant organzational workflow problems and coordinated solution with stakeholders efficently and rapidly to troubleshoot them organization-wide
Coordinated with internal and external stakeholders to resolve complex procurement-related issues and ensure operational continuity
Specified, planned and developed semi-automated reports and dashboards for management decision-making
Supported procurement decisions and validated budget requests for core operational units
Led and supervised a small team of soldiers in administrative and financial tasks

Co-led the development and deployment of an IDF-wide procurement subsystem to enhance financial tracking and transparency, coordinating and resolving issues among stakeholders, technical teams, subject-matter experts, management, customers, and suppliers
Designed and implemented standardized workflows for expense tracking and reporting
Received the IDF Commanding Officer Excellence Award (\texthebrew{הצטיינות אלוף}), 2021
